fields.title: Custom fields
fields.hint: Ten per object at most, and that is a decision: an unlimited system produces forty undocumented columns in a year, twelve of which say the same thing — and no report stays readable.
fields.label: Field label
fields.archiveHint: Archive: the field stops being offered, its values stay readable.
fields.archived: Field archived — its values stay readable.
fields.error: The field could not be saved.

duplicates.title: Duplicates spotted
duplicates.hint: {{brand}} merges near-certain duplicates on its own (same address and same name), in {{brand}} only — never in your CRM — and you can undo it. The others it PROPOSES: you decide.
duplicates.decided: Decision recorded — this pair will not come back.
duplicates.error: The decision could not be recorded.
duplicates.setAside_one: {{count}} archived or merged account is left out of the comparison.
duplicates.setAside_other: {{count}} archived or merged accounts are left out of the comparison.
duplicates.noReport: The last search reported nothing: this is not a measurement.
duplicates.skipped_disabled: No search ran: duplicate search is switched off by the operator.
duplicates.skipped_demo: No search ran: duplicate search does not run on a demo workspace.
duplicates.scanFailed: The duplicate search did not complete: this is not “no duplicate”. It retries the next time this opens.
duplicates.setAsidePair: “{{left}}” ({{leftStatus}}) and “{{right}}” ({{rightStatus}}) share the same name, but one of them is set aside: the pair is not proposed.
duplicates.restored: Account unarchived: it now joins the comparison.
duplicates.restoreError: The account could not be unarchived.

autoMerged.title: Merged by {{brand}}
autoMerged.lineSameName: “{{name}}” (duplicate) was merged into the record we kept.
autoMerged.why: {{reason}} — {{value}}% confidence. Merged in {{brand}} only: your CRM was not touched.
autoMerged.undone: Merge undone: the record is back, and this pair will not be matched again.
autoMerged.undoError: The merge could not be undone.

duplicates.bannerOpenHint: {{brand}} proposes the merge; nothing is merged without you, except a certain identity (≥ 0.99), always reversible.
duplicates.bannerAutoHint: A certain identity was merged inside {{brand}} only; you can undo each merge.

placeholderEmails.title: Template addresses
placeholderEmails.hint: An address like “firstname.lastname@…” reaches nobody. Count first: nothing is written until you confirm. The previous value stays in the record’s history, and an address set by hand is never touched.
placeholderEmails.kept_one: ({{count}} kept by hand, left as is)
placeholderEmails.kept_other: ({{count}} kept by hand, left as is)
placeholderEmails.none: No template address in this workspace.
placeholderEmails.done_one: {{count}} address cleared, the previous value is in the record’s history.
placeholderEmails.done_other: {{count}} addresses cleared, the previous value is in each record’s history.
placeholderEmails.remaining: Some remain: count again for the next batch.
placeholderEmails.error: The count did not complete. Try again.
